name: PIERCING SHOT
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Farstalker operative shoots with a Kroot rifle, Kroot scattergun or the focused dual Kroot pistols, that weapon has Piercing 1 until the action ends. Not in the same action as Toxin Shot.

name: TOXIN SHOT
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Farstalker operative shoots with a Kroot rifle, Kroot scattergun or the focused dual Kroot pistols, that weapon has Lethal 5+ and Stun until the action ends. Not in the same action as Piercing Shot.

name: MEAT
text: A strip of raw meat: once per turning point, as a friendly Farstalker operative that is not a Hound starts its activation clear of enemy control ranges, it heals up to D3+1 lost wounds.

name: TROPHY
text: Once per battle a friendly Farstalker operative (not a Hound) that is clear of enemy control ranges can claim a trophy before or after one of its actions: +1 APL for the rest of that activation.
